You should try the following : check your connection, disable ad-blocker, clear your browser cache, try in private mode, try from another browser/computer/connection. 0 Civolution Dear student beings, I and the cosmic faculty of the Technical Academy of Creation warmly welcome you to your Civolution, the most important exam in the field of Civilization Design. For those who do not know me, my name is Agera, and, as the directorial entity of this institution, I am responsible for conducting the exam. This time, we have chosen a humanoid base scenario on a secluded continent. Each of you is assigned the role of a local deity, closely bound to your own civilization, and tasked with leading it to success in competition with the others. The developmental possibilities are endless, ranging from cultural and technological progress to evolutionarybiological adaptations. For example, what would advance your own civilization more: the invention of the wheel or growing wings? Prove that you can master the control of your console and that you can adapt to variable environmental parameters as well as various creation-chaotic conditions. The exam ends after four eras. Whoever has gathered the most success points with their civilization by then will not only pass the exam but will also have the opportunity to ascend to the next level as a full member of the Technical Academy of Creation. I wish you all a successful Civolution! Number of players: 1 - 4 Game duration: 79 mn Complexity: 5 / 5 Play Civolution and 1414 other games online. No download necessary - play directly from your web browser. With your friends and thousands of players from the whole world. Free. No download necessary - play directly from your web browser. With your friends and thousands of players from the whole world. Free. Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary Contents 1 Playing on BGA: the interface 1.1 The screen 1.2 Tips 1.3 Preferences 1.4 Setup 1.5 How a round plays 1.6 The action phase in detail 1.7 Undo 1.8 Marker supply 2 Differences from the physical game 2.1 Marker supply (50 pieces) Playing on BGA: the interface This summary explains how to play with the interface . It does not replace the rulebook, which remains the reference for modules, cards and scoring. The screen At the top, the boards : on the left, the progress board with the tracks and the displays (goal chips, income chips, attribute chips) and the final scoring row; in the middle, the continent ; on the right, the phase sequence (the marker shows the current phase), the weather gauge, the eras, the Favor of Agera track and the events. Four layout buttons above the boards: All boards , Continent only , Continent under boards , Boards under continent . Your choice is remembered for each table. The research stacks : the five card types (A to E), each with its draw pile and discard pile. Your hand of research cards, just above the consoles. The consoles of all players, yours first. The player panels , on the right: food, money, idea and focus, your dice, and the farm, settlement and boat counters. A counter warns you when that supply is exhausted. A navigation bar on the left edge of the screen jumps straight to the boards, the continent or any console. Tips Hover : almost everything has a tooltip. Pieces, track spaces, phases, weather, cards and chips. Whatever you can click pulses (or grows, depending on the Animations preference). Hold Shift to hide tribes and pieces, Ctrl to hide tokens, and see the tiles underneath. Read the title bar : it always says what is expected. When a button has clickable content (for instance skipping a cost space of a card), a small line under the buttons explains it. Preferences In the BGA preferences menu: Consoles layout : one or two columns of consoles, or automatic depending on screen width. Player hand : the hand floats at the bottom of the screen and unfolds on hover, or stays fixed above the consoles. By default it floats on desktop and is fixed on mobile. Animations : full, without pulsing, or off. Setup Each player chooses to be a newcomer or an advanced player , then confirms. Everyone chooses their starting cards, then clicks Confirm selection . Everyone chooses their starting chip card. A confirmation reminds you that you keep it for the whole game. In solo, the V.I.C.I level is chosen at the start and shown on the start button. [Rating: 1/10] Useless actions/sections, very loose design, uninspired point salad with ~20 scoring options. Very high variance game impacting RNG on multiple levels. Exploration, fishing for a useful card, a goal that won't block you and slow your game down, very low manipulation on dice etc. etc. If this is Feld's best, it feels 10 years too late with the games it's trying to recycle from. Yearly euroslop.
